title: Add onboarding gated-lint plus contextual sampled changelog preview (autodraft)
author: Asha Menon
ci_status: pass (unit tests + e2e sampling harness rerun)
description: Motivation: onboarding new model variants often produces noisy changelogs and blocks engineers from quickly validating compatibility. This PR adds two coordinated features: 1) a gated lint step for model intake metadata that enforces semantic contract expectations for key fields (version, family, affinity tags, quantization_hint, sample_seed_policy) and emits machine-readable failure codes; 2) an autodraft changelog preview generator that uses sampling heuristics to produce a compact impact digest containing sampled output deltas, latency percentiles, and token-cost estimates. Design: the lint is implemented as a pluggable rule set under registry/validation/rules with a small DSL for 'soft' vs 'hard' failures. Gate rules are configurable per-namespace via .onboard/config.yaml and can be overridden for backfills. The changelog preview runs the new sample-runner that pulls 200 deterministic prompts from the model-profile test-bench, runs them against baseline and candidate variants with bounded concurrency, computes a delta-summary (micro-F1 on structured outputs, median latency, p95 tokens, sample failure rate), and renders a concise markdown blob limited to 800 characters plus attachable CSV of sampled cases. Privacy: sampled outputs are hashed and optionally redacted by a redaction policy defined in registry/privacy/policies. CLI: new subcommand `redwood mr onboard preview --profile <profile> --seed-policy sample-seed-policy` and `redwood mr lint --file model.yaml --strict` to run in CI. Rollout plan: feature gated behind org flag model_registry_autodraft and rollout to canary teams for two weeks with a telemetry opt-in. Backwards compatibility: lint rules default to non-failing (warnings) unless `--strict` passed or namespace enforces. Implementation notes: added sample-runner, lightweight evaluation adapter for existing eval-harness, lint rule DSL, config schema bump (v1.3), changelog renderer and a tidy CLI wrapper. Tests: unit tests for rule parsing, integration test that runs the sample-runner against a small dockerized dummy model, and e2e that asserts preview size limits and CSV attachment shape. Related: ENG-4187 defines the gating policy, ENG-4221 is the sampling budget work. Why this change: reduces time to acceptance for model onboarding by surfacing a compact, actionable preview for reviewers and catching common metadata issues early.
